verdict.rationale: Global employment is a fair axis for a PEO and payroll provider, so it applies. However, no evidence item documents employer-of-record or owned-entity payroll for people in other countries. The one hint is a 'Domestic' option under Make a Payment, which only implies a non-domestic path and does not show international employment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll
